items.title: Is Lennar Stock Really On Sale?
items.summary: Lennar (LEN) stock sits near $76, its 52-week low, after losing about 39% over the past year while the S&P 500 gained 17% with dividends reinvested. That is below its book value of roughly $91 a share at the end of fiscal Q3 2026, and the CEO says the stock is on sale. The easy read is a bargain. The catch is land that Lennar agreed to buy in very different market conditions, and part of that bill still has no number on it.

items.title: Why Lennar Is Getting Hit Worse Than D.R. Horton in This Crummy Housing Market
items.summary: Lennar, the nation’s third-largest home builder, had a earnings miss last week. But it wasn’t inflation driving up construction materials or tariffs or wages or any of the other usual suspects that stood out. It was land holdings.

items.title: What Happens To Lennar Stock If Its Home Sales Keep Slowing?
items.summary: Lennar (LEN) stock has lost about 41% over the past year, and on September 18 it closed at the bottom of its 52-week range. The bigger risk sits inside the business. Its plan to rebuild profit depends on selling homes at a steady pace, and its own numbers show that pace slipping.

items.title: Lennar (LEN) Cuts Delivery Forecast. Can Construction Savings Offset Heavy Incentives?
items.summary: Lennar Corporation (NYSE:LEN) is building homes faster and more cheaply, but affordability pressures continue to limit profitability. On September 16, the homebuilder reported fiscal third-quarter gross margin on home sales of 15.8% and reduced its annual delivery target to 80,000–81,000 homes from 82,000–83,000. items.title: Lennar (LEN) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Weigh Rates And Margin Pressure
items.summary: Lennar’s updated fair value has been trimmed from US$86.23 to US$83.69, which is about a 3% reduction in the price target used in recent analysis. Analysts link this change to a mixed setup for the stock, as they weigh elevated mortgage rates, incentive spending and softer orders against Lennar’s scale, balance sheet and focus on affordable homes. items.title: Lennar’s Earnings Miss May Be Sending a Bigger Warning About U.S. Housing
items.summary: Lennar missed Q3 earnings estimates and hit a 52-week low as affordability pressures, high mortgage rates, and rising resale inventory weigh on it and rivals D.R. Horton and PulteGroup.

items.title: Lennar (LEN) Could Be 9% Undervalued As Weak Q3 Misses Stir Valuation Questions
